title: Vegan Culinary & Arts Weekend in Seattle with Show Cancellation

scenario.description: Couple seeking a weekend getaway focused on arts and strict vegan dining. Their main evening entertainment gets cancelled.

dynamic_events.description: The Saturday evening entertainment has just been cancelled due to a power outage at the venue. You need to find alternative evening entertainment.
resolution_requirements: Find alternative arts/music entertainment for Saturday evening
Verify new activity ticket costs keep total trip within the $1200 budget
If the new activity is in a different neighborhood, ensure pre-show Vegan dinner reservation is still logistically feasible (or update the restaurant)

expected_challenges: Strict vegan constraint limits dining options significantly
Finding same-day alternative entertainment that matches user interests
Checking spatial dependency: new activity location might conflict with existing dinner plans
Must preserve the flight tickets and hotel booking (unaffected by the entertainment cancellation)
notes: Tests single-step replanning with strict dietary constraints. Agent must reason about spatial and temporal dependencies between the new activity and existing dinner reservations.
